extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: wristwatch with 38 mm case on a watch pillow, pillow 8 x 5.6 x 3.8 cm
extras.notes: front faces -Y; gold watch case with crown, light blue dial with applied gold index bars and minute dots (no numerals, no text), domed crystal (alpha glass), caramel leather strap with cream stitching, gold prong buckle and keeper, wrapped around a sage velvet watch pillow; dial faces up, 12 o'clock points to +Y; movable: 'wristwatch_hand_hour', 'wristwatch_hand_minute' and 'wristwatch_hand_second' have their origin in the dial centre and turn around Z (clockwise = negative angle), set to 10:10; no brand, no logo

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
